requestedIntent: Make ACEF Full four-actor-v3 use one bounded worker contract from dispatch through repair, fail fast on incoherent state, preserve authentic evidence, and keep review inputs story-scoped without duplicating lifecycle work or source context.
limitations: Existing active runs remain compatibility-readable and may require one bounded recovery checkpoint before their next phase transition.
Delta-readiness scope is mechanically checked at dispatch boundaries, but the quality of a declared ambiguity still depends on the conductor and reviewer.
The capability is enforced rather than proven until controlled product canaries demonstrate lower time-to-first-product-commit without increased escaped defects.

evidence.note: Exercises Full v3 capsule startup, authentic RED handoff, phase progression, and terminal closeout compatibility.
Exercises coherent REVISE-to-Development transition, bounded repair retry, and hash-bound reference capsules through deterministic closeout.
Covers persisted objective heartbeats and bounded active-control accounting.
Covers installed runtime defaults and flag-preserving refresh commands.
